name: Opolyx
summary: Opolyx is a free online multiplayer board game about buying, developing and trading property. Two to six players move around a 40-square board, buy streets and companies, build houses and hotels on complete colour sets, bid in auctions and trade with each other, until one player is left or the round limit is reached. Computer players fill empty seats. There are eight modes, among them Speed with a third die, a 25-round Blitz, Team games of two or three a side, a Halal mode without interest or betting, and a Chinese-themed Fortune mode. It runs in the browser in twelve languages, with an iOS app and a browser extension.
